description: deleteDnsRecord: Stage deletion of a DNS record. DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible once executed. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId; present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name the record belongs to, e.g. 'example.com'.

recordId.description: Identifier of the record to delete, as returned by listDnsRecords.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: deleteDnsRecord
